Method of Attack: Ransomware written in Python compiled with PyInstaller
Encrypts files under %UserProfile% folder with specific extensions using AES encryption
Creates alert.jpg ransom note and sets it as Windows desktop wallpaper
Intends to use a TOR payment site for ransom payment
Attack Vector: Distribution of a Windows executable ransomware compiled from Python
Indicators of Compromise: Static password 'test' used for encryption in development version
Encrypted files have '(encrypted)' prepended to filename
